title: feat(codegen): generate typed reducers for document models
description: Codegen now emits a typed reducer stub per operation, so model authors get compile errors instead of runtime ones.

steps: Run ph generate on the todo-list model
Open the generated reducer and remove one case
Confirm tsc reports the missing operation

revertNote: Re-run codegen in every model package after reverting.
head: feat/codegen-typed-reducers
